title: Handley Page Halifax JP190
memorial_details: Rectangular red metal plaque attached to a cairn. An image of the Halifax is shown in blue, both side view and head-on. The lettering is in white. This memorial is not at the crash site
inscription: In Memory/ of the crew of/ Halifax Mk II JP 190/ which crashed near here/ on the night of 1st April 1944/ with the loss of all 8 crew/ (Names) Erected 1st April 1994 by Nos. 2465 (Currie & Balarno) Squ./ 1007 (Duns) Squ. Air Training Corps, and the Forestry Commission.
community_connection: Erected 1st April 1994 by Nos. 2465 (Currie & Balarno) Squ./ 1007 (Duns) Squ. Air Training Corps, and the Forestry Commission.
